question: Which of the following is not a part of the human excretory system?
solution:
The correct answer is **option (2)** i.e. **'Trachea'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In humans, the kidney is one of the** main organs of the excretory system**.
 
• The function of the** kidney is to filter the blood and remove waste (toxic) products**.
 
• Waste products and excess fluids are removed through urine.
 
• If the kidney gets damaged then the person has to undergo dialysis.
 
• **Dialysis** is a treatment that filters and purifies the blood using a machine.
 
• The human excretory system consists of organs that **remove wastes such as salts, carbon dioxide, urea, uric acid, and water** produced by the body.
 
• The route of urine in the human excretory system is After being filtered by
 
 
• **kidney → urine through ureter → stored in bladder → out through urethra.**
